title: Doodle Wood Product Record
description: Canonical product record for Doodle Wood. ONE record per product, version-controlled, feeding every downstream surface. Deliberately sparse-tolerant: only identity fields are required, everything else may be null or absent. A blank field means 'not captured yet', never 'does not apply' — use the explicit null and the `_gaps` array to say which.

x-surfaces.shop: shop.doodle-wood.com — Shopify operator store. The live commerce + fulfilment surface. Authoritative for price, inventory, order state.
x-surfaces.brand: doodle-wood.com — brand/story site built and managed in Lovable via Claude Desktop cowork code. Reads narrative and media; does NOT own commerce.
x-surfaces.notion: Doodle Wood Company Library. Authoritative for brand voice, positioning, pricing policy, concept register.
x-surfaces.booth: Festival booth / in-person POS and printed signage.
x-surfaces.wholesale: B2B line sheets and QR plaque quoting.
x-surfaces.affiliate: Partner, referral and affiliate link surfaces.

id.description: Stable internal ID. Never changes, never reused, survives renames and platform migrations. This is the join key across every system.

sku.description: Base SKU. Variant SKUs extend this. Format DW-<TYPE>-<CHAR><SIZE>.

handle.description: URL slug. Must match the Shopify handle exactly or deep links between brand site and shop break.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'concept' means it exists only as a doodle in the register; 'active' means sellable now.

version.description: Bump when the physical design changes enough that old photos are wrong.

classification.description: How the piece is grouped and found.

character.description: Which recurring Doodle Wood character this is. Links to the Doodle Concept Register in Notion.

gift_occasion.description: Drives seasonal merchandising and ad targeting.

narrative.description: The story layer. This is what makes it Doodle Wood rather than laser-cut stock. Owned by Notion, mirrored here.

origin_story.description: Where this doodle actually came from. The brand's core promise is that these escaped a real notebook — if that is unknown for a piece, leave null rather than inventing one.

grain_note.description: How the wood talked back on this design — knots as eyes, grain as rivers.

voice_warnings.description: Words or claims never to use for this piece (e.g. 'do not call it rustic', 'never say food-safe').

physical.description: The object itself. Feeds shipping rates, care instructions and booth signage.

weight_g.description: REQUIRED for accurate shipping rates. Signs are heavier than they look.

one_of_one.description: True if literally unique. Changes refund copy and inventory handling.

safety_notes.description: Not food-safe / not fire-resistant / small parts. Legally load-bearing — see terms-of-service.html.

production.description: Internal only. Never rendered on a customer surface.

burn_minutes.description: Bench time per piece. The real constraint on this business.

blank_source.description: Where the wood blank comes from.

cogs.description: Total cost of goods. Drives the margin check in validate.py.

difficulty.description: 1 = anyone can burn it, 5 = only Mike.

workshop_suitable.description: Can this be a $30 'Burn Your Own' seat? Notion records workshop seats as the highest-throughput item, so this flag is commercially significant.

commerce.description: Money. Shopify is authoritative once live; this is the intended state.

booth_price.description: Cash price at a festival booth. Often differs from online — record it rather than letting it live only in someone's head.

margin_pct.description: Derived from price and cogs. Recomputed by validate.py, not hand-entered.

inventory_on_hand.description: Snapshot only. Shopify is the live source.

variants.description: Empty array is valid for single-variant products.

media.description: CURRENT BLOCKER: every product in the live store has zero images. This block exists to make that gap explicit and trackable rather than invisible.

alt_text.description: Accessibility requirement, not optional at launch.

burn_video.description: Ties to the 'Watch a Piece Get Burned' homepage CTA.

source_doodle.description: Scan of the original sketchbook page. The provenance asset.

photography_status.description: Launch gate. Anything not 'published' blocks that product going live.

surfaces.description: WHERE THIS PRODUCT LIVES. Each surface is independently toggleable — a piece can be boothed before it is ever listed online.

brand.description: doodle-wood.com — Lovable-built brand site. Story surface only; it has no cart by design. Any 'buy' affordance here must deep-link to the shop.

lovable_component.description: Component or route in the Lovable project that renders this.

deep_link_to_shop.description: Where the brand site sends a buyer. Must carry UTM params — see channels.utm_default.

display_tier.description: Impulse items go at the register; heroes go at eye level.

qr_target.description: QR code on booth signage. Notion records QR plaques as the highest-value repeat B2B item.

channels.description: Affiliate, referral and attribution. Kept separate from `surfaces` because a link can exist without the product being listed on that surface.

utm_default.description: Default UTM query string appended to inbound links.

short_link.description: Canonical short link used in bios and on printed material.

affiliate_links.description: Outbound affiliate/partner links FOR this product. Empty is fine and expected early.

ugc.description: True if made by a customer, not us. Notion's marketing doctrine targets ~42 UGC pieces per event.

canonical_url.description: Critical: brand site and shop must not compete for the same term. Point the canonical at the shop for anything transactional.

sources.description: Provenance. Every claim in this record should be traceable to one of these. This is what makes the record auditable rather than folklore.

concept_register_ref.description: Entry in the Doodle Concept Register.

internal_docs.description: Any other internal document feeding this record.

last_verified_against_shopify.description: When this record was last checked against live Shopify. Stale records are how the plan drifts from reality.

confidence.description: Mirrors the Notion Ventures convention. 'assumed' means nobody has checked.

_gaps.description: Explicit, machine-readable list of what is knowingly missing from this record. A field being null is ambiguous; naming it here is not. validate.py reports on these instead of silently passing sparse records.
